name: listRealms
title: List Realms
description: Discovers and lists all configured realms in the target PingAM / AIC deployment. Returns realm names, paths, aliases, and active status. Use this tool to find available realms dynamically in any deployment instead of guessing or using hardcoded names.

_def.description: Optional CREST query filter (default: "true" to list all realms). Example: name sw "cust"
